insight.title: Why You Say Yes to Favors You Don’t Want to Do
insight.subtitle: How to stop filling your future schedule with tasks you’ll regret.

sections.text: We often agree to a commitment for next week that we would reject if it were happening in ten minutes. We treat our future time as if it were an infinite, free resource.
Your brain views your "future self" as a stranger. Since you don’t feel the immediate stress of the task, you prioritize short-term social ease over the reality of your actual workload and energy.
This habit creates a calendar full of obligations you never truly wanted. You trade your long-term focus for a fleeting moment of politeness, leaving your future self to pay for your past decisions.
The next time you receive a request today, ask if you would say yes for this afternoon.

news.title: Oricell Therapeutics Closes $110 Million Pre-IPO Financing to Accelerate Global Development of Solid Tumor CAR-T Therapies
news.description: SHANGHAI, April 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oricell Therapeutics Holdings Limited ('Oricell'), a global clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering innovative cancer immunotherapies, today announced the cumulative closing of a pre-IPO financing round in excess of $110 million. The round was co-led by Vivo Capital, Beijing Medical and Health Care Industry Investment Fund, Qiming Venture Partners, and a leading global healthcare fund. The syndicate included an international sovereign wealth fund, E-Town Capital, Luxin Venture Capital, NGS Super, Elikon Investment, and Talon Capital.
news.why: Increased funding accelerates the arrival of new life-saving treatments for cancer.
